description: This file defines a class 'Size' in the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing implementations for the Excel functions LARGE and SMALL to find the nth largest or smallest value in a dataset, with helper functions for filtering and error handling.

classes.name: Size
classes.description: Provides static methods to calculate the nth largest or smallest value in a dataset, mimicking Excel's LARGE and SMALL functions.

methods.name: large
methods.description: Returns the nth largest value from a set of values, similar to Excel's LARGE function.

methods.name: small
methods.description: Returns the nth smallest value from a set of values, similar to Excel's SMALL function.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters an array of arguments to include only numeric values, used internally by large and small functions.
